## 2B.10 Research Note: Lula, Brazil, 2024

**Bottom line:** **Mostly yes, by inference.** Lula’s 2024 foreign-policy record is more peaceful and law-oriented than the conflict-heavy context he inherited: he pushed disarmament diplomacy, ceasefire language, multilateral crisis management, and humanitarian restraint. The main offsets are rhetorical and diplomatic frictions around Gaza and the Ukraine peace initiative, which weakened but did not overturn the broader de-escalatory pattern.

### Accepted claims

- **Claim:** Lula institutionalized disarmament diplomacy in 2024.
  - **Title:** [Decreto nº 12.237, de 25 de outubro de 2024](https://www.planalto.gov.br/ccivil_03/_Ato2023-2026/2024/Decreto/D12237.htm)
  - **Publisher:** Presidência da República / Planalto
  - **Date:** October 25, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://www.planalto.gov.br/ccivil_03/_Ato2023-2026/2024/Decreto/D12237.htm
  - **Claim-level summary:** The decree created Brazil’s permanent delegation to the Conference on Disarmament in Geneva. That is a concrete move toward a more lawful and institutionally managed international posture.
  - **Question IDs:** `2B.10`; also `1B.4`, `1B.6`, `1B.10`

- **Claim:** Brazil’s official security framework remained treaty-based and non-peaceful-use prohibitive.
  - **Title:** [Tratados e regimes com reflexos para a Defesa](https://www.gov.br/defesa/pt-br/assuntos/relacoes-internacionais/foruns-internacionais-1/tratados-e-regimes)
  - **Publisher:** Ministério da Defesa
  - **Date:** Updated 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://www.gov.br/defesa/pt-br/assuntos/relacoes-internacionais/foruns-internacionais-1/tratados-e-regimes
  - **Claim-level summary:** The page says Brazil joined the NPT, the Constitution forbids non-peaceful nuclear use, and ABACC subjects the program to independent safeguards. This is strong background evidence that Lula’s Brazil remained on a lawful, defensive track.
  - **Question IDs:** `2B.10`; also `1B.5`, `1B.6`, `1B.7`

- **Claim:** Lula repeatedly used direct dialogue and ceasefire language on the Ukraine war.
  - **Title:** [Brazil and China sign joint proposal for peace negotiation in the Russia-Ukraine war](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/05/23/brasil-e-china-assinam-proposta-conjunta-de-negociacao-de-paz-para-guerra-da-ucrania-e-russia.htm)
  - **Publisher:** Reuters via UOL
  - **Date:** May 23, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/05/23/brasil-e-china-assinam-proposta-conjunta-de-negociacao-de-paz-para-guerra-da-ucrania-e-russia.htm
  - **Claim-level summary:** The joint statement said dialogue and negotiation were the only viable solution and called for conditions to resume direct talks and move toward a comprehensive ceasefire. That is evidence of a more peaceful and law-oriented diplomatic approach.
  - **Question IDs:** `2B.10`; also `2B.1`, `2B.7`, `1B.8`

- **Claim:** Lula reinforced that line at the UN by warning against militarization and nuclear threats.
  - **Title:** [Speech by President Lula at the opening of the 79th UN General Assembly in New York](https://www.gov.br/g20/en/documents/speeches/speech-by-president-lula-at-the-opening-of-the-79th-un-general-assembly-in-new-york)
  - **Publisher:** Brazil G20 / Ministry of Foreign Affairs
  - **Date:** September 24, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://www.gov.br/g20/en/documents/speeches/speech-by-president-lula-at-the-opening-of-the-79th-un-general-assembly-in-new-york
  - **Claim-level summary:** Lula said military spending and nuclear arsenals were driving confrontation and that direct dialogue was crucial. This supports the view that Brazil’s international posture became safer and more stabilizing.
  - **Question IDs:** `2B.10`; also `1B.1`, `1B.2`, `1B.8`, `2B.7`

- **Claim:** Lula also rejected a return to nuclear threats in a separate 2024 multilateral speech.
  - **Title:** [President Lula's speech at the Summit of the Future opening in New York](https://www.gov.br/g20/en/documents/speeches/president-lulas-speech-at-the-summit-of-the-future-opening-in-new-york)
  - **Publisher:** Brazil G20 / Ministry of Foreign Affairs
  - **Date:** September 22, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://www.gov.br/g20/en/documents/speeches/president-lulas-speech-at-the-summit-of-the-future-opening-in-new-york
  - **Claim-level summary:** Lula said the world could not go back to living with nuclear threats and tied that warning to arms-race criticism and multilateral reform. This is consistent with leaving Brazil’s international posture more lawful and less dangerous.
  - **Question IDs:** `2B.10`; also `1B.1`, `1B.2`, `1B.8`, `2B.7`

- **Claim:** Brazil joined a Gaza declaration demanding ceasefire, hostages release, and humanitarian aid.
  - **Title:** [Brasil assina declaração conjunta pelo fim dos ataques sobre Gaza](https://agenciagov.ebc.com.br/noticias/202406/declaracao-conjunta-sobre-gaza)
  - **Publisher:** Agência Gov / MRE
  - **Date:** June 6, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://agenciagov.ebc.com.br/noticias/202406/declaracao-conjunta-sobre-gaza
  - **Claim-level summary:** The declaration said hostilities should stop, hostages should be released immediately and unconditionally, and humanitarian aid should reach civilians. That is strong evidence of a more peaceful and lawful international posture.
  - **Question IDs:** `2B.10`; also `2B.4`, `2B.7`, `2B.8`

- **Claim:** Brazil’s climate diplomacy in 2024 paired external ambition with measurable domestic improvements.
  - **Title:** [Deforestation drops 30.6% in the Amazon and 25.7% in the Cerrado in 2024](https://www.gov.br/mma/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/taxa-de-desmatamento-na-amazonia-cai-30-6-e-25-7-no-cerrado)
  - **Publisher:** Brazil Ministry of Environment and Climate Change / INPE
  - **Date:** November 6, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://www.gov.br/mma/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/taxa-de-desmatamento-na-amazonia-cai-30-6-e-25-7-no-cerrado
  - **Claim-level summary:** Official 2024 deforestation estimates fell sharply versus 2023, including the Amazon’s lowest level in nine years. While not a classic security issue, it improved Brazil’s international standing and reduced a major cross-border catastrophic-risk source.
  - **Question IDs:** `2B.10`; also `4A`, `1B.7`

### Counterevidence / caveats

- **Claim:** Lula’s Gaza rhetoric caused a diplomatic rupture with Israel.
  - **Title:** [Lula repeats that the Israeli government commits genocide in Gaza and defends the creation of a Palestinian state](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/02/23/lula-repete-que-governo-israelense-comete-genocidio-em-gaza-e-defende-criacao-de-estado-palestino.htm)
  - **Publisher:** Reuters via UOL
  - **Date:** February 23, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/02/23/lula-repete-que-governo-israelense-comete-genocidio-em-gaza-e-defende-criacao-de-estado-palestino.htm
  - **Claim-level summary:** The report says Lula’s comments triggered a major diplomatic rupture with Israel. This is the clearest negative signal for 2B.10, because it increased tension rather than stabilizing relations.
  - **Question IDs:** `2B.10`; also `1B.2`, `1B.8`, `2B.9`

- **Claim:** Ukraine criticized the Brazil-China peace initiative as exclusionary.
  - **Title:** [Ukraine's Zelenskiy dismisses 'destructive' China-Brazil peace initiative](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/ukraines-zelenskiy-dismisses-destructive-chinabrazil-peace-initiative-3612966)
  - **Publisher:** Reuters via Investing.com
  - **Date:** September 12, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/ukraines-zelenskiy-dismisses-destructive-chinabrazil-peace-initiative-3612966
  - **Claim-level summary:** Zelenskiy said Kyiv was not included and argued the plan lacked respect for Ukraine’s territorial integrity. This weakens the credibility of Lula’s peace initiative and is the main caveat on the international-law/process side.
  - **Question IDs:** `2B.10`; also `1B.4`, `1B.8`, `2B.7`

### Search gap

I did **not** find a clean before/after metric for “more peaceful, stable, and lawful than inherited.” So the conclusion is an inference from:
- stronger disarmament and ceasefire diplomacy,
- active use of multilateral institutions,
- improved climate governance and deforestation results,
- and limited but real rhetorical/diplomatic blowback.

If you want, I can turn the full 2B series into a single scored memo with a one-line verdict per lens.
